initialization: Normal nonzero head weights, common per seed; old32 decoder projection preserved, new8 columns zero
evaluation: four independent draw losses averaged, not averaged predictions
conditioning_definition: C,Y are raw observations determining all cached query inputs. Loss target is phi(Y). C is not asserted identical to decoder DINO features.
information_scope: Conditional on fixed learned weights, I(Y;W|C,z0)<=1 nat for a single independent Gaussian draw; not a deterministic-mean or prediction-ensemble bound.
observed_sets: 512 train; 64 and96 already research-observed evaluation; no fresh final test
seed_scope: Head initialization+batch+noise vary; common decoder initial weights
